document_metadata.title: 3、INT PIER BUILDING -- NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Durant, asserting dominance, tortures Black by snipping his fingers with a cigar cutter while listing his points, following a tense standoff over property refusal and threats.

entities.name: Black confronts Durant with three demands
entities.description: Black addresses Durant, declaring he will not sell his property, asserting no one can intimidate him, and threatening violence if they persist.

entities.description: Black engages Skip in brief banter, commenting on his limp and joking about having been engaged to a woman with a wooden leg, which briefly lightens the tension.

entities.description: The dock workers respond with laughter to Black's joke about the wooden leg, showing camaraderie before the confrontation resumes.

document_metadata.summary: After the SCREAM stops, Durant leaves with his men, leaving Peyton in a gas-filled lab. Peyton regains consciousness, crawling toward a drinking bird near an ignition source, as gas valves leak explosively.

entities.name: Durant activates oxygen and acetylene tanks

entities.description: The beak of the drinking bird gradually descends due to its mechanical motion, eventually making contact with the electronic lighter, likely igniting the released gases.

Since Peyton is the one speaking, the relation is interpreted as the Dark Figure (who is Peyton) speaking aloud, thus 'speaks_to' captures this momentary act of speech directed contextually toward Julie, though the text identifies the speaker as Peyton. Given the identity revelation, the subject 'Dark Figure' is effectively Peyton speaking, making this a self-contained moment of speech. However, to preserve the extraction within allowed relations and based on the explicit spoken content, 'speaks_to' is the only valid, text-grounded relation, even if the target of speech is implied rather than explicitly named in the relation object. But since the object is 'Peyton' and the subject is 'Dark Figure', and they are the same entity, this creates a self-referential issue. Therefore, no valid relation between 'Dark Figure' and 'Peyton' as distinct entities can be supported. Hence, despite the presence of speech, the relation cannot be accurately rewritten without misrepresenting the entities.

entities.name: Durant signals for silence at subway tunnel intersection

entities.description: Durant directs Trumayne to take one tunnel while he and Guzman proceed down another, splitting the group in the dark subway system.

entities.description: After detecting a faint cough ahead, Trumayne picks up a wine bottle and hurls it toward the sound, attempting to provoke or detect a presence.

entities.description: When the thrown wine bottle vanishes without making impact, Trumayne becomes increasingly terrified, interpreting the event as evidence of something unnatural in the darkness.

entities.description: Overcome by dread after the unexplained disappearance of the bottle and repeated coughing, Trumayne starts backing out of the tunnel to return the way he came.

entities.name: Figure emerges from darkness and is shot by Durant and Guzman
entities.description: A figure runs toward Durant and Guzman from the blackness; they respond by firing multiple shots, causing the figure to lurch and collapse onto the railroad ties.

entities.name: Trumayne's body is revealed, gagged and bound

entities.name: Strack tears off Durant's face

entities.name: Strack and Darkman engage in a physical battle on a narrow girder
entities.description: Strack and Darkman fight each other on a narrow girder suspended high above the ground, with both men exchanging blows while at risk of falling to their deaths.

entities.name: Darkman delivers a series of powerful punches to Strack
entities.description: Darkman lands multiple forceful blows on Strack, causing him to stagger and fall onto the girder, temporarily gaining the upper hand in the fight.

entities.name: Strack crawls toward a nearby rivet gun
entities.description: After being knocked down, Strack begins to crawl across the girder toward a cluster of tools, with the rivet gun within close reach.

entities.name: Darkman attacks Strack with renewed intensity
entities.description: Darkman leaps onto Strack and begins pummeling him, consumed by the desire for final revenge, preventing Strack from reaching the tools.

entities.name: Darkman slips on loose rivets while preparing a final strike
entities.description: As Darkman steps back to deliver a decisive blow, he loses his footing on scattered rivets, causing him to flail and lose balance on the narrow girder.

entities.name: Strack lunges and knocks Darkman into a vertical bar
entities.description: Taking advantage of Darkman's slip, Strack lunges forward and causes Darkman to crash into a vertical support bar with a loud clang.

entities.name: Rivet gun fires bolts through Darkman's wrists
entities.description: The rivet gun discharges rapidly, shooting metal bolts through both of Darkman's wrists and pinning him to the I-beam, immobilizing him.

entities.name: Strack retreats in exhaustion after subduing Darkman
entities.description: Following the successful use of the rivet gun to pin Darkman, Strack steps backward, visibly drained from the intense confrontation.

entities.name: Strack threatens Julie with imminent death
entities.description: Strack, having subdued Darkman, turns his attention to Julie and menacingly declares that she will now die, advancing toward her as she cowers in fear.

entities.name: Strack approaches a terrified Julie
entities.description: After defeating Darkman, Strack walks toward Julie, who is visibly frightened, signaling his intent to harm her.

document_metadata.title: 100、INT. CONSTRUCTION ELEVATOR
document_metadata.summary: Darkman, disguised and scarred, evades Julie's search in the crowd, ultimately revealing his charred face to a street person with a menacing warning before disappearing into the night.

entities.name: Julie touches Darkman's shoulder to comfort him
entities.description: Julie gently touches Darkman's shoulder in an attempt to draw him toward her and offer emotional support while he faces away in shadows.

entities.description: Julie tells Darkman that she loves him and that his burns do not matter to her, expressing her emotional commitment.

entities.description: Darkman laments that his hand, once capable of tenderness, now only tears and destroys, and that his inner self has changed irreparably.

entities.name: Julie pleads that Darkman will recover and be whole again
entities.description: Julie anxiously insists that Darkman will perfect his synthetic skin and that they can return to their former life together.

entities.description: Darkman physically pulls the elevator doors open, signaling his intention to depart and separate from Julie.

entities.description: Darkman states that while he has accepted his new existence, he believes no one else, including Julie, can truly endure it.

entities.description: Julie expresses deep emotional pain, crying as she says she wants their old life and love to return as it once was.

entities.name: Darkman mourns the loss of their life together in daylight
entities.description: Darkman reflects that their love and shared life belonged in the light and implies it cannot survive in his current shadowed existence.
